intent: Analyze System State Baseline for Massive Framerate Drop Across Games
detected_fault: Massive Framerate Drop Across Games (2/3 to 3/4 reduction in framerates)
suggested_solution: Run a thorough stress test on the system using tools like Prime95, OCCT, or FurMark to identify any potential thermal or power-related issues.
Check for any firmware updates for the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop and Intel Core i9 processor.
Perform a clean boot of the system to isolate any software-related issues.
